children: South Africa fintech platform's fiscal Q4 revenue rose 0.8% yr/yr
Adjusted EPS for fiscal Q4 increased to $0.15 from $0.05 yr/yr
Company achieved GAAP profitability for first time since 2022 creation
Lesaka sees FY2027 net revenue between ZAR 7.0 bln and ZAR 7.7 bln
Company expects FY2027 adjusted EBITDA between ZAR 1.45 bln and ZAR 1.60 bln
Lesaka forecasts FY2027 adjusted EPS between ZAR 7.50 and ZAR 8.50
CONSUMER SEGMENT GROWTH - Consumer segment revenue rose 31% yr/yr in Q4, with segment adjusted EBITDA up 56%
ENTERPRISE SEGMENT EXPANSION - Enterprise segment revenue climbed 91% yr/yr in Q4, with segment adjusted EBITDA up 255%
MERCHANT SEGMENT DECLINE - Merchant segment revenue fell 14% yr/yr in Q4, with segment adjusted EBITDA down 33%
Q4 Net Income attributable to Lesaka
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "strong buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 2 "strong buy" or "buy", no "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the financial technology (fintech) peer group is "buy."
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Lesaka Technologies Inc is $7.58, about 67.6% above its September 8 closing price of $4.52
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 9 three months ago
